requirement_text: Upon submission, the system shall validate and check for duplicate or invalid entries.
user_story: As a user, I want my submission checked for duplicate or invalid entries, so that bad data is not saved.
technical_task: On submission, validate the entries and check them for duplicates and invalid values.
acceptance_criteria: Given a submission with an invalid entry, when it is submitted, then the invalid entry is detected.
Given a submission with a duplicate entry, when it is submitted, then the duplicate is detected.
rationale: Role assumed: user. What happens after detection is not stated.

requirement_text: In case of hardware failure or database corruption, users shall be redirected to a replacement page.
user_story: As a user, I want to be redirected to a replacement page when hardware fails or the database is corrupted, so that I see a clear page instead of an error.
technical_task: Redirect users to a replacement page in case of hardware failure or database corruption.
acceptance_criteria: Given a hardware failure, when a user requests a page, then the user is redirected to a replacement page.
Given database corruption, when a user requests a page, then the user is redirected to a replacement page.
rationale: Role assumed: user.

requirement_text: System shall ensure that transactions reflect accurately in databases without any data loss.
user_story: As an account holder, I want transactions to be reflected accurately in the databases without data loss, so that my records are correct.
technical_task: Write every transaction to the databases completely and accurately.
acceptance_criteria: Given a transaction, when it completes, then it is reflected accurately in the databases.
Given a series of transactions, when they are all complete, then none of their data is missing from the databases.
rationale: Role assumed: account holder.

requirement_text: LHCPs can edit or delete future appointments .
user_story: As an LHCP, I want to edit or delete future appointments, so that my schedule stays correct.
technical_task: Allow an LHCP to change or remove appointments that lie in the future.
acceptance_criteria: Given a future appointment, when the LHCP edits it, then the changes are saved.
Given a future appointment, when the LHCP deletes it, then it is removed.
rationale: Role stated: LHCP. The limit to future appointments is taken from the requirement.

requirement_text: The system shall provide guidance to new publishers after signup.
user_story: As a new publisher, I want guidance after signing up, so that I know how to start publishing.
technical_task: Show guidance to publishers right after signup.
acceptance_criteria: Given a publisher who has just signed up, when signup completes, then guidance is shown.
Given the guidance, when the publisher reads it, then it explains how to get started as a publisher.
rationale: Role stated: new publisher. The content of the guidance is not described.

requirement_text: Click on a person's name to edit their contact information or click 'Add New' to enter a new contact into your address book.
requirement_text_raw: Click on a person's name to edit their contact information  or click 'Add New' to enter a new contact into your address book.
user_story: As a user, I want to click a person's name to edit their contact information, or click Add New to enter a new contact in my address book, so that my contacts stay current.
technical_task: Make names in the address book open for editing and provide an Add New control for new contacts.
acceptance_criteria: Given the address book, when the user clicks a person's name, then the contact information can be edited.
Given the address book, when the user clicks Add New, then a new contact can be entered.
rationale: Role assumed: user.

requirement_text: In the Twitter settings menu, the system shall allow the user to delete their saved username and password for Twitter.
user_story: As a user, I want to delete my saved Twitter username and password in the Twitter settings menu, so that my credentials are no longer stored.
technical_task: Add an option in the Twitter settings menu that deletes the saved Twitter username and password.
acceptance_criteria: Given saved Twitter credentials, when the user deletes them in the Twitter settings menu, then the saved username and password are removed.
Given the credentials were deleted, when the user opens the settings, then no saved username or password is shown.
rationale: Role assumed: user.

requirement_text: The LHCP is provided a bar chart of diagnosis counts during the specified time period as well as a yes or no answer on whether an epidemic is occurring during any consecutive two weeks during the time period.
user_story: As an LHCP, I want a bar chart of diagnosis counts for a time period and a yes or no answer on whether an epidemic occurs in any two consecutive weeks, so that I can spot outbreaks.
technical_task: Show a bar chart of diagnosis counts for the specified time period and a yes or no indicator on whether an epidemic is occurring during any two consecutive weeks of that period.
acceptance_criteria: Given a specified time period, when the LHCP requests the report, then a bar chart of diagnosis counts is shown.
Given the same time period, when the report is shown, then it includes a yes or no answer on whether an epidemic is occurring during any two consecutive weeks of the period.
rationale: Role stated: LHCP. The epidemic rule is not defined in the sentence.

requirement_text: Administrator shall be able to handle complaints regarding content by providing solutions or forwarding the issue to the related department and communicating the solution to the user.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to handle content complaints by providing a solution or forwarding the issue to the related department and telling the user the solution, so that complaints are resolved.
technical_task: Provide complaint handling in which the administrator resolves a content complaint or forwards it to the related department and communicates the solution to the user.
acceptance_criteria: Given a content complaint, when the administrator resolves it, then the solution is communicated to the user.

Given a content complaint that the administrator cannot resolve, when the administrator forwards it to the related department, then the department receives it and the solution is later communicated to the user.
rationale: Role stated: administrator.

requirement_text: User shall be able to delete an activity by selecting it on the canvas and clicking the "Delete" button on the user GUI.
user_story: As a user, I want to delete an activity by selecting it on the canvas and clicking the Delete button, so that I can remove activities I no longer need.
technical_task: Add a Delete button to the GUI that removes the activity selected on the canvas.
acceptance_criteria: Given an activity selected on the canvas, when the user clicks the Delete button, then the activity is deleted.
Given no activity selected on the canvas, when the user clicks the Delete button, then nothing is deleted.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The second criterion is an assumption.

requirement_text: The system shall allow staff members to evaluate consistency with the comprehensive plan during application reviews.
user_story: As a staff member, I want to evaluate consistency with the comprehensive plan during application reviews, so that approvals follow the plan.
technical_task: Add a consistency evaluation against the comprehensive plan to the application review process.
acceptance_criteria: Given an application under review, when staff evaluate it, then they can record whether it is consistent with the comprehensive plan.
Given the review of an application, when it is completed, then the consistency evaluation is part of the review.
rationale: Role stated: staff member.

requirement_text: Admin shall be able to display offers for specific restaurant.
user_story: As an admin, I want to display offers for a specific restaurant, so that customers see its offers.
technical_task: Allow the admin to publish and show offers for a chosen restaurant.
acceptance_criteria: Given a restaurant, when the admin adds an offer for it, then the offer is displayed for that restaurant.
Given two restaurants, when an offer is added for one, then it is not displayed for the other.
rationale: Role stated: admin.

requirement_text: Data collection devices (e.g. – handheld devices etc.) synchronize with the System securely using authentication authorization and encryption mechanisms.
requirement_text_raw: Data collection devices (e.g. – handheld devices  etc.) synchronize with the System securely using authentication  authorization and encryption mechanisms.
user_story: As a security officer, I want data collection devices such as handheld devices to synchronize with the System using authentication, authorization and encryption, so that synchronization is secure.
technical_task: Secure synchronization of data collection devices with the System using authentication, authorization and encryption mechanisms.
acceptance_criteria: Given a data collection device, when it synchronizes with the System, then it is authenticated and authorized first.
Given a synchronization, when data is transferred, then it is encrypted.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. The garbled example in the source text is not used.

requirement_text: System shall be able to manage bills for clients, including clearance receipt, freight fare, and delivery charges, and maintain complete records of payments.
user_story: As a logistics clerk, I want to manage bills for clients including clearance receipt, freight fare and delivery charges, and keep complete payment records, so that billing is traceable.
technical_task: Implement bill management for clients covering clearance receipt, freight fare and delivery charges, and store complete payment records.
acceptance_criteria: Given a client, when the clerk creates a bill, then clearance receipt, freight fare and delivery charges can be included.
Given a payment is made on a bill, when it is recorded, then it is kept in the client's payment records.
rationale: Role assumed: logistics clerk.

requirement_text: Agricultural exports shall be able to post information for users to view by entering agricultural news, books, and technology developments for display.
user_story: As an agricultural exporter, I want to post agricultural news, books and technology developments for users to view, so that information is shared.
technical_task: Provide posting of agricultural news, books and technology developments that other users can view.
acceptance_criteria: Given an agricultural exporter, when the exporter enters agricultural news, books or technology developments, then they are saved for display.
Given posted information, when users open the page, then it is displayed to them.
rationale: Role stated: agricultural exporter ("Agricultural exports" in the source).

requirement_text: System shall ensure efficient email communication for trainers via the website.
rationale: "Efficient" is not measurable and the email functions are not specified.
clarification_questions: What does "efficient" mean for email communication (delivery time, volume)?
Which email functions must the website provide for trainers?

requirement_text: The details described in Other Applicable Document SPEC LV 124-2, Appendix A [LH-5383] shall be taken into account when conducting the tests.
rationale: The sentence only refers to another document.
clarification_questions: What do SPEC LV 124-2 Appendix A require for the tests?
Is the referenced document part of this requirement?

requirement_text: For a velocity equal or larger than 266 km/h (corrected speedometer velocity which is displayed to the driver) this bit is set to `` 1 ''.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want a bit set to 1 for corrected speedometer velocities of 266 km/h or more, so that high speed is signalled.
technical_task: Set the bit to 1 when the corrected speedometer velocity shown to the driver is equal to or larger than 266 km/h.
acceptance_criteria: Given a corrected speedometer velocity of 266 km/h or more, when it is displayed to the driver, then the bit is set to 1.
Given a corrected speedometer velocity below 266 km/h, when it is displayed to the driver, then the bit is not set to 1 by this rule.
rationale: Role assumed: driver assistance engineer. Which bit is meant is not stated in the sentence.

requirement_text: User shall be able to log out securely.
user_story: As a user, I want to log out securely, so that nobody can use my session afterwards.
technical_task: Provide a logout function that ends the session securely.
acceptance_criteria: Given a logged-in user, when the user logs out, then the session is ended.
Given a logged-out session, when someone uses the old session, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: user.

requirement_text: Communication services shall provide "immediate" message passing services in the form of "pipes". "Pipes" provide fast data throughput between virtual groups or within a virtual group when minimal data latency is necessary.
requirement_text_raw: Communication services shall [SRS048] provide "immediate" message passing services in the form of "pipes". "Pipes" provide fast data throughput between virtual groups or within a virtual group when minimal data latency is necessary.
user_story: As a software developer, I want communication services to provide "immediate" message passing in the form of "pipes", so that data moves quickly between virtual groups when latency must be minimal.
technical_task: Provide "immediate" message passing as "pipes" for fast data throughput between virtual groups or within one virtual group when minimal data latency is needed.
acceptance_criteria: Given two virtual groups, when an application uses a "pipe", then data passes between them.
Given a single virtual group, when an application uses a "pipe", then data passes within it.
rationale: Role assumed: software developer. How fast "fast" is is not specified.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to view the Menu from the dashboard.
user_story: As a user, I want to view the Menu from the dashboard, so that I can see what is on offer.
technical_task: Link the Menu from the dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: Given the dashboard, when the user opens it, then the Menu can be accessed.
Given the dashboard, when the user selects the Menu, then the Menu is displayed.
rationale: Role assumed: user.

requirement_text: The status of a laboratory procedure has been updated (UC26 S3).
requirement_text_raw: The status of a laboratory procedure has been updated (UC26  S3).
rationale: The sentence reports a completed status update (UC26 S3) and states no behaviour to implement.
clarification_questions: Is this a statement of a result rather than a requirement?
What must the system do when the status of a laboratory procedure is updated?

requirement_text: The user shall be able to set notification parameters for an assignment.
user_story: As a student, I want to set notification parameters for an assignment, so that I am reminded the way I choose.
technical_task: Add notification settings to each assignment.
acceptance_criteria: Given an assignment, when the user sets notification parameters, then they are saved.
Given saved notification parameters, when the assignment is due, then notifications follow them.
rationale: Role assumed: student. Which parameters exist is not listed.

requirement_text: The system shall prioritize traveler privacy regarding location tracking within the mobility domain.
rationale: "Prioritize" is not testable and the behaviour is not specified.
clarification_questions: What does "prioritize privacy" require in testable terms?
Which location tracking data and mobility domain functions are involved?

requirement_text: System shall confirm all transactions with the customer’s web browser.
user_story: As a customer, I want transactions confirmed with my web browser, so that I know they went through.
technical_task: Send a confirmation of each transaction to the customer's web browser.
acceptance_criteria: Given a completed transaction, when it finishes, then a confirmation is shown in the customer's web browser.
Given a failed transaction, when it ends, then no confirmation of success is shown.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. The garbled apostrophe in the source was read as "customer's".

requirement_text: System shall tolerate existing datasets if their properties are different but compatible when creating a dataset as part of app deployment.
user_story: As an app developer, I want existing datasets with different but compatible properties to be tolerated when a dataset is created during app deployment, so that deployment does not fail needlessly.
technical_task: When creating a dataset during app deployment, accept an existing dataset if its properties differ from the requested ones but are compatible.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing dataset whose properties differ but are compatible, when the app is deployed, then the existing dataset is accepted.
Given an existing dataset whose properties are incompatible, when the app is deployed, then it is not accepted.
rationale: Role assumed: app developer. What counts as compatible is not defined.

requirement_text: CNG shall be able to classify intra-LAN traffic that is simply bridged by the CNG itself within the CPN.
user_story: As a network engineer, I want the CNG to classify intra-LAN traffic that it simply bridges within the CPN, so that such traffic can be handled by class.
technical_task: Classify intra-LAN traffic that the CNG bridges itself within the CPN.
acceptance_criteria: Given intra-LAN traffic bridged by the CNG within the CPN, when it passes through, then the CNG classifies it.
Given traffic not bridged by the CNG itself, when it passes through, then this requirement does not apply.
rationale: Role assumed: network engineer. The classes are not listed.

requirement_text: The product shall retain the customer's buying preferences and information.
requirement_text_raw: The product shall retain the customer's buying preferences and information.'
user_story: As a customer, I want the product to remember my buying preferences and information, so that I don't have to enter them again.
technical_task: Store each customer's buying preferences and information for later use.
acceptance_criteria: Given a customer's buying preferences and information, when they are entered, then they are stored.
Given a returning customer, when the customer uses the product again, then the stored preferences and information are available.
rationale: Role stated: customer.

requirement_text: - `` 99 '': object is closer than the nominal distance (very ciritical, CPA warning in IC).
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want the value 99 signalled when an object is closer than the nominal distance, so that a critical situation is flagged.
technical_task: Output the value 99 when an object is closer than the nominal distance, as a very critical condition with a CPA warning in the instrument cluster.
acceptance_criteria: Given an object closer than the nominal distance, when the sensor reports, then the value 99 is output.
Given the value 99, when it is received, then it indicates a very critical condition with a CPA warning in the instrument cluster.
rationale: Role assumed: driver assistance engineer. The text is a value definition; it is read as an output rule.

requirement_text: The application should be installable on Microsoft or Unix platforms and compatible with browsers such as IE, Firefox, Chrome, Opera, or Safari.
user_story: As a user, I want to install the application on Microsoft or Unix platforms and use it with browsers such as IE, Firefox, Chrome, Opera or Safari, so that I can use my usual setup.
technical_task: Make the application installable on Microsoft and Unix platforms and compatible with the browsers IE, Firefox, Chrome, Opera and Safari.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Microsoft or Unix platform, when the application is installed, then the installation succeeds.
Given IE, Firefox, Chrome, Opera or Safari, when the application is used in it, then it works.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Should" makes this a recommendation.

requirement_text: An HCP chooses to refer a patient to another receiving HCP through the referral feature on a patient's office visit page (UC11).
user_story: As an HCP, I want to refer a patient to another receiving HCP through the referral feature on the patient's office visit page, so that the patient gets further care.
technical_task: Add a referral feature on the patient's office visit page that sends a patient to another receiving HCP (UC11).
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient's office visit page, when the HCP chooses to refer the patient, then the HCP can select a receiving HCP.
Given a selected receiving HCP, when the HCP confirms the referral, then the patient is referred to that HCP.
rationale: Role stated: HCP.

requirement_text: The system shall allow staff members to update transactional parcel pins to reference the GIS layer for split or merged parcels.
user_story: As a staff member, I want to update transactional parcel pins to reference the GIS layer for split or merged parcels, so that records match the map.
technical_task: Allow staff to update the transactional parcel pins so they reference the GIS layer for parcels that are split or merged.
acceptance_criteria: Given a split parcel, when staff update its transactional parcel pins, then they reference the GIS layer.
Given a merged parcel, when staff update its transactional parcel pins, then they reference the GIS layer.
rationale: Role stated: staff member.

requirement_text: The solution should provide the ability to extract data for administrative purposes.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to extract data for administrative purposes, so that I can use it in reports.
technical_task: Provide a data extraction function for administrative purposes.
acceptance_criteria: Given data in the solution, when an authorized administrator requests an extraction, then the data is extracted.
Given an extraction, when it completes, then the extracted data is available to the administrator.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. Which data and format are not specified.

requirement_text: The available recycled parts information and their suppliers shall be returned to the user.
user_story: As a customer, I want to be shown the available recycled parts and their suppliers, so that I can choose where to buy.
technical_task: Return the list of available recycled parts together with their suppliers.
acceptance_criteria: Given available recycled parts, when the user requests them, then the parts are returned.
Given an available recycled part, when it is returned, then its supplier information is returned with it.
rationale: Role assumed: customer.

requirement_text: For a transient NE failure, FDIR shall mask the failed NE.
requirement_text_raw: For a transient NE failure, FDIR shall (3.3.5.24) mask the failed NE.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want FDIR to mask a failed NE after a transient failure, so that the system continues without it.
technical_task: Mask the failed NE in FDIR when the NE failure is transient.
acceptance_criteria: Given a transient NE failure, when FDIR handles it, then the failed NE is masked.
Given an NE without a failure, when FDIR checks it, then it is not masked.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer.

requirement_text: The system shall operate smoothly and respond to user actions with minimal delay.
rationale: "Smoothly" and "minimal delay" are not measurable.
clarification_questions: What does "smoothly" mean and what response time counts as "minimal delay"?
Which user actions does this cover?

requirement_text: The recycled parts audit report shall be returned to the user within 10 seconds. The audit report shall be returned within 10 seconds.
requirement_text_raw: The recycled parts audit report shall be returned to the user within 10 seconds.  The audit report shall be returned within 10 seconds.'
user_story: As an adjuster, I want the recycled parts audit report returned within 10 seconds, so that I can continue my work.
technical_task: Return the recycled parts audit report to the user within 10 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given a request for a recycled parts audit report, when it is processed, then the report is returned within 10 seconds.
Given a response that takes longer than 10 seconds, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: adjuster. The sentence is repeated in the source.

requirement_text: System shall be able to display an error message and eject the device if the transaction is unsuccessful.
user_story: As a customer, I want an error message and my device ejected when a transaction is unsuccessful, so that I know it failed.
technical_task: Display an error message and eject the device when a transaction does not succeed.
acceptance_criteria: Given an unsuccessful transaction, when it ends, then an error message is displayed.
Given an unsuccessful transaction, when the error message is displayed, then the device is ejected.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. The device type is not stated.

requirement_text: A customer shall be able to add a special dietary requirement to an order by dragging the requirement from the engaged menu onto the order.
requirement_text_raw: A customer shall be able to add a special dietary requirement to an order by  dragging the requirement from the engaged menu onto the order.
user_story: As a customer, I want to add a special dietary requirement to an order by dragging it from the engaged menu onto the order, so that my need is recorded.
technical_task: Allow a dietary requirement to be dragged from the engaged menu onto an order to attach it.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order and the engaged menu, when the customer drags a special dietary requirement onto the order, then it is added to the order.
Given an order with a dietary requirement, when it is viewed, then the requirement is shown.
rationale: Role stated: customer.

requirement_text: This page contains a list of your clinic's users.
rationale: The sentence only describes what a page contains.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or a description of a page?
What must the system do on this page?

requirement_text: The status information includes the condition (open / closed) of doors, engine hood and tailgate when the alarm is triggered.
user_story: As a vehicle owner, I want the status information to include whether the doors, engine hood and tailgate are open or closed when the alarm is triggered, so that I know what was open.
technical_task: Include the open or closed condition of the doors, engine hood and tailgate in the status information when the alarm is triggered.
acceptance_criteria: Given the alarm is triggered, when the status information is produced, then it includes whether the doors are open or closed.
Given the alarm is triggered, when the status information is produced, then it includes whether the engine hood and tailgate are open or closed.

user_story: As an enterprise architect, I want the web service to be portable across platforms, so that it integrates into various enterprise applications.

requirement_text: The Finish Window with Statistics is completed by the player, see chapter 3.2.2.2.
user_story: As a player, I want to complete the Finish Window with Statistics, so that my results are recorded.
technical_task: Provide a Finish Window with Statistics that the player completes (see chapter 3.2.2.2).
acceptance_criteria: Given the game has finished, when the Finish Window with Statistics is shown, then the player can complete it.
Given the Finish Window with Statistics, when the player completes it, then the entries are recorded.

requirement_text: Users shall be able to clear all assignments for a particular class.
user_story: As a teacher, I want to clear all assignments for a particular class, so that I can reset it.
technical_task: Add a function that removes every assignment of a chosen class.
acceptance_criteria: Given a class with assignments, when the user clears all assignments, then none remain for that class.
Given another class, when the user clears one class, then the other class's assignments are unchanged.
rationale: Role assumed: teacher.

requirement_text: The Disputes application shall comply with the corporate standards for user interface creation for internally and externally used applications.
requirement_text_raw: The Disputes application shall comply with the corporate standards for user interface creation for internally and externally used applications.'
user_story: As a product owner, I want the Disputes application to follow the corporate standards for user interface creation, so that it looks like our other applications.

acceptance_criteria: Given the Disputes user interface, when it is reviewed against the corporate standards, then it complies.
Given the user interface screens, when they are reviewed, then they comply for both internal and external use.

requirement_text: User shall/will be able to access online shopping opportunities.
user_story: As a customer, I want to access online shopping opportunities, so that I can buy online.
technical_task: Provide access to the online shopping functions.
acceptance_criteria: Given the application, when the user opens the shopping area, then online shopping options are shown.
Given an online shopping option, when the user selects it, then it opens.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. What the opportunities are is not described.

requirement_text: The FTPP system shall be able to accommodate power up of all 5 channels and maintain all 5 NEs active, assuming no failures.
requirement_text_raw: The FTPP system shall (3.1.19) be able to accommodate power up of all 5 channels and maintain all 5 NEs active, assuming no failures.

acceptance_criteria: Given no failures, when the FTPP system powers up, then all 5 channels are powered up.
Given all 5 channels are powered up with no failures, when the system runs, then all 5 NEs remain active.

requirement_text: The system shall allow batch ingest of ETDs with embargo and permission settings.
user_story: As a librarian, I want batch ingest of ETDs with embargo and permission settings, so that many theses are loaded at once.
technical_task: Support batch ingest of ETDs together with embargo and permission settings.
acceptance_criteria: Given a batch of ETDs, when the librarian ingests it, then all ETDs in the batch are ingested.
Given an ETD with embargo and permission settings, when it is ingested, then the settings are applied.
